abilities.description: Sleeping Krayt: When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2f2ba4090b22a122]{Enter the Fray} using martial prowess, on a hit, you may fill the meter below and take -1 on it to add +2 to any @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.723192c97fec4fe2]{Clash} during combat.

Rancor Rising: Your takedown game is unmatched. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.723192c97fec4fe2]{Clash} in close quarters, you may take -1 to your meter and @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.93d2d69b7e2b85e1]{Lose Momentum} (-2) and choose one (before rolling):

  • Opportunistic: Count a strong hit as a strong hit with a match.
  • Gang up: An ally who is fighting alongside you takes +2 on their next @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.723192c97fec4fe2]{Clash}.

Spitting Rawl: You've learned deadly strike points on multiple species. You may burn 10 momentum and take -2 to your meter. If you do, you automatically defeat a single Troublesome-level foe, or take four progress against all other level foes.
